intended_behavior: Update the __init__ method to handle cases where get_config returns None, which happens when the project configuration file does not exist. Instead of throwing a TypeError, the code should raise a clear and user-friendly exception or provide guidance on initializing the project. This ensures the system does not fail silently or in an unclear manner during first-time project setup. The rest of the existing functionality, including setting up text_embedding for the "OpenAI" platform and raising NotImplementedError otherwise, should remain unchanged.
